Give objects generous empty space and show whole objects without clipping. No beach scene, water, extra rocks, pedestals, containers, buildings, people, realistic fur or surface microdetail, writing, labels, borders, logos or watermark. One 768x768 square image; opaque background is intentional. City Sim VR beach-prop concept study.
